experiences.name: Cherry Blossom Viewing in Maruyama Park
experiences.description: Experience the magical hanami tradition under Kyoto's most famous weeping cherry tree in Maruyama Park. Join locals for a traditional picnic beneath the blossoms, enjoy street food stalls selling sakura mochi and yakitori, and witness the stunning illuminated trees after dark. A quintessential family-friendly cultural experience that captures the heart of Japanese spring.

experiences.name: Senso-ji Temple and Nakamise Shopping Street
experiences.description: Explore Tokyo's oldest and most iconic Buddhist temple, founded in 628 AD. Walk through the Thunder Gate (Kaminarimon) and browse the vibrant Nakamise shopping street lined with traditional crafts, snacks, and souvenirs. Kids will love drawing omikuji fortune slips and watching the incense ceremony. A perfect blend of history, culture, and family fun in one compact area.

experiences.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum and Park
experiences.description: A profoundly moving and historically significant experience for families and history enthusiasts. Walk through the Peace Memorial Park, view the preserved Atomic Bomb Dome, and explore the museum's thoughtful exhibits documenting the events of 1945 and the city's remarkable recovery. The experience fosters reflection, empathy, and a deep appreciation for peace. Suitable for children aged 10 and above.
experiences.location: Peace Memorial Park, Naka Ward, Hiroshima

experiences.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Dive into Japan's legendary food culture with a self-guided or guided tour of the bustling Tsukiji Outer Market. Sample fresh sushi, tamagoyaki (sweet rolled omelette), grilled scallops, matcha ice cream, and seasonal street snacks. Vendors are family-friendly and many offer tastings. This is an unmissable culinary adventure that introduces the whole family to authentic Japanese flavors and market culture.
experiences.location: Tsukiji Outer Market, Chuo City, Tokyo

experiences.name: Nijo Castle and Nishiki Market Cultural Day
experiences.description: Combine a visit to the stunning 17th-century Nijo Castle — a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its 'nightingale floors' that chirp when walked upon — with an afternoon stroll through Nishiki Market, Kyoto's beloved 'Kitchen of Kyoto.' Kids will be fascinated by the squeaky floors and samurai history, while the whole family can taste pickled vegetables, fresh tofu, and local sweets along the narrow market lane.
experiences.location: Nijo Castle and Nishiki Market, Central Kyoto
